Our Process

From waste to worth in three transformative stages

1

Tailings Collection

Sourcing mining byproduct from operations worldwide, recovering a waste stream with massive potential.

2

Treatment & Processing

Proprietary combination of physical and chemical processes, including alkali activation. Recovers valuable metals and water.

3

Product Manufacturing

Creating high-performance materials: concrete, aggregates, geopolymers, and urban furniture for sustainable cities.

Our Products

Transforming mining waste into high-performance construction materials

🏗️

Eco-Concrete

High-strength concrete made from processed mine tailings, reducing CO₂ emissions by up to 60% compared to traditional concrete.

⚙️

Artificial Aggregates

Sustainable aggregates for construction, manufactured through thermal processing of tailings.

🧪

Geopolymers

Advanced binding materials with superior chemical resistance and fire protection capabilities.

🪑

Urban Furniture

Durable benches, planters, and street furniture crafted from recycled tailings.

🏛️

Foundation Materials

High-performance structural foundations using tailings-derived concrete for superior load-bearing capacity.

🧱

Paving Blocks

Interlocking paving stones for sidewalks, plazas, and parking areas with exceptional durability.

🛣️

Road Materials

Sub-base and surface materials for road infrastructure, engineered for long-term performance.
